title: 第1388章 域主令第1387章 你究竟哪头的
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 帝坟山深处。
一片独立的空间之中。
这里存在着一个恢弘无比的古宗，名为帝坟宗。
帝坟宗道统无比悠久，已历经数万年岁月，堪称隐世古宗。
这数万年来，帝坟宗诞生了无数风华绝代的传奇人物，其内更是天骄妖孽纵横。
只不过，帝坟宗的修士却是很少问世，至少很少在下三重天仙域活跃，所以下三重天鲜有人知道帝坟宗的存在。
唯有极少数人，在一些隐秘的典籍中，看到过一些零星的记载。
此刻。
帝坟宗。
“什么？持帝令者已经进入了帝坟山？走，我们去会会他，我倒是要看看，他究竟有何资格，敢来迎娶我帝坟宗的圣女。”
“哼，区区蛮夷，竟也敢来我帝坟宗争夺机缘，甚至还敢妄想迎娶我帝坟宗圣女，真是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，我倒真想见识一下，他究竟有何不凡。”
“嘿嘿，区区贫瘠之地的蛮夷能有何不凡？只不过是运气好走了狗屎运，这才得到了帝王令而已，待我们将他踩在脚下，看他还有没有脸来我帝坟宗。”
“呵呵，诸位不必着急，他想来我帝坟宗，那也要看看有没有那个本事，可千万别还没来到帝坟宗，便死在了外面的坟山之内。”
伴随着洛依传回消息，霎时间，无数年轻一代都疯狂了。
一道道声音从各大山头和殿宇传出，许多天骄妖孽都是纷纷出动，摩拳擦掌，向着外面的帝坟山赶了过去。
原因很简单，竟有人要来帝坟宗迎娶他们的圣女，并且还要与他们争夺某个极其重要的机缘，这让他们怎么能忍呢？
最关键的是，那人还并非是来自其他古老道统，隐世大宗，而是来自外界的下三重天仙域，这就让他们更是不能忍了。
青婵是谁？那可是帝坟宗当代最为杰出耀眼的圣女，堪称风华绝代，光芒万丈。
她年纪轻轻，修为便是已经达到仙王境界，镇压的所有帝坟宗年轻一代都抬不起头。
这样风华绝代的女子，绝对是帝坟宗所有年轻一辈心目中的女神，他们别说是妄想迎娶青婵了，甚至就连追随，都是遥不可及的梦。
而今，竟然有人欲以一块令牌，一个约定，迎娶他们心目中的女神，这让他们如何能够接受呢？
“嗖嗖嗖——”
霎时间，一道道破空之音在帝坟宗内响彻，只是短短时间，便有无数年轻一代离开宗门，冲向了外界的帝坟山。
与此同时，
帝坟山深处，
一座殿宇之中。
两名老者正相对而坐。
左侧老者抬头看了一眼外面，低沉的说道：
“哎，真是没有想到，万载岁月过去，那位的传人竟还真的来了，就是不知她那传人修为如何，能否配得上我帝宗圣女。”
右侧老者闻言，端起面前的茶杯，轻轻抿了一口，淡淡道：
“先看看吧，他若行，那一切都自然好说，若不行，就只能从哪儿来，再回哪儿去了。”
“那位虽然很强，且我帝坟宗也的确是欠下了她莫大的恩情，但也不能委屈我们的圣女。”
“若他实力太差，天赋太低，就算撕毁约定也没什么，历经万载岁月，我帝坟宗也早已不再是万年前的帝坟宗，纵使她亲临，想必也无话可说。”
content_en:
Deep in the Emperor's Tomb Mountain.
In an independent space.
There is an extremely magnificent ancient sect here called the Emperor's Tomb Sect.
The Imperial Tomb Sect has an extremely long tradition, having gone through tens of thousands of years, and can be called a hidden ancient sect.
Over the past tens of thousands of years, the Emperor's Tomb Sect has given birth to countless legendary figures of unparalleled splendor, among whom there are even more prodigies and evildoers.
However, monks from the Emperor's Tomb Sect rarely appear, at least rarely active in the lower third-level heavenly realm, so few people in the lower third-level heaven know about the existence of the Emperor's Tomb Sect.
Only a handful of people have seen some sporadic records in some secret books.
now.
Emperor's Tomb Sect.
"What? The person holding the Emperor's Order has entered the Emperor's Tomb Mountain? Come on, let's go meet him. I want to see what qualifications he has to dare to marry the saint of our Emperor's Tomb Sect."
"Hmph, a mere barbarian actually dares to come to our Emperor's Tomb Sect to compete for opportunities, and even dares to dream of marrying the saint of our Emperor's Tomb Sect. It's really a toad that wants to eat swan meat. I really want to see how extraordinary he is."
"Hey, how can a barbarian from a barren land be so extraordinary? It's just a matter of good luck that he got the emperor's order. After we trample him under our feet, let's see if he still has the nerve to come to our Emperor's Tomb Sect."
"Haha, you don't have to worry. If he wants to come to our Emperor's Tomb Sect, he has to see if he has the ability. But he must not die in the tomb outside before he comes to the Emperor's Tomb Sect."
As soon as Luo Yi sent back the news, countless young people went crazy.
Voice after voice came from the mountains and palaces, and many geniuses and monsters rushed out, gearing up, and rushed towards the Emperor's Tomb Mountain outside.
The reason is very simple. Someone actually wants to come to the Emperor's Tomb Sect to marry their saint, and they also want to compete with them for an extremely important opportunity. How can they endure this?
The most important thing is that that person is not from other ancient sects or hidden sects, but from the lower third level of the outside world, which makes them even more intolerable.
Who is Qingchan? She was the most outstanding and dazzling saintess of the Emperor's Tomb Sect in the contemporary era. She was extremely majestic and radiant.
She is young, but her cultivation has already reached the realm of the Immortal King, and all the younger generations of the Emperor's Tomb Sect who are suppressed cannot hold their heads high.
Such a gorgeous woman is definitely the goddess in the hearts of all the younger generations of the Imperial Tomb Sect. Not to mention their delusional desire to marry Qingchan, even following her is a distant dream.
Now, someone actually wants to marry the goddess in their eyes with a token and an agreement. How can they accept this?
"Swish swish——"
In an instant, a series of piercing sounds resounded in the Emperor's Tomb Sect. In just a short time, countless young people left the sect and rushed to the Emperor's Tomb Mountain in the outside world.
At the same time,
Deep in the Emperor’s Tomb Mountain,
In a palace.
The two old men were sitting opposite each other.
The old man on the left looked up and looked outside, and said in a low voice:
"Hey, I really didn't expect that after tens of thousands of years, that descendant would actually come. I just don't know what the cultivation level of her descendant is, and whether she can be worthy of our emperor's saint daughter."
Hearing this, the old man on the right picked up the tea cup in front of him, took a sip, and said calmly:
"Let's see first. If he can do it, then everything will be easy. If he doesn't, he can only go back to where he came from."
"Although that person is very strong, and our Emperor's Tomb Sect indeed owes her a great debt of gratitude, we cannot wrong our Saint."
"If his strength is too low and his talent is too low, it won't matter even if he breaks the agreement. After thousands of years, our Emperor's Tomb Sect is no longer the Emperor's Tomb Sect ten thousand years ago. Even if she comes in person, she will probably have nothing to say."
